sources.entry: Easy!Appointments - Allows your customers to book appointments with you via the web. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Easy!Appointments is a self-hosted, web-based appointment scheduling system that lets customers book appointments with you online.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a self-hosted scheduling platform for managing appointments, customers, services, and providers. It covers working plans and booking rules, Google Calendar synchronization, and email notifications. The interface is available in multiple languages. Production installation uses PHP with a MySQL database and a browser-based setup wizard. A Docker Compose environment is provided for local development, using npm and Composer for dependencies and npm scripts for dev and build steps.
use_cases: online appointment booking for a business
letting customers schedule services on my website
managing provider working hours and availability
self-hosted alternative to hosted booking services
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd into easyappointments
docker compose exec php-fpm bash (in a second terminal)
npm install && composer install (inside the container)
npm start (development watcher) or npm run build (production assets)
Production: create a MySQL database, upload the folder, make storage writable, rename config-sample.php to config.php, then run the setup wizard in the browser
notable: Fully self-hosted, so booking data stays on your own server
Working plans and booking rules for providers
Installed via a setup wizard after uploading files and editing config
caveats: Requires PHP 8.2+ and a MySQL database plus a web server (Apache or Nginx)
README mentions premium features and professional services offered separately at easyappointments.org/premium
Docker development setup is described as working on Windows via WSL (recommended), macOS, and Linux
